content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer a range of features, including payment processing, subscription management, and analytics, but their primary function is to act as a middleman between creators and their customers. They take a commission on every sale, and in the case of account suspension, creators can lose access to their funds and customer data. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a sovereign digital commerce stack that allows creators to deploy their own infrastructure, own their customer data, and keep 100% of their revenue without any commission or fees. This stack includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, which can be deployed in 48 hours, configured for SPF, DKIM, and DMARC, and tested end-to-end before handoff. With Edge Commerce Stack, creators can load up to 5 products, manage subscriptions, and deliver digital products to their customers without relying on third-party platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle's geographic restrictions are well-documented, with many countries facing outright bans or severe limitations on payment processing. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack is designed to operate in any country, regardless of the restrictions imposed by these platforms. By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can sidestep these restrictions and deploy their own infrastructure, allowing them to sell digital products to customers in any country without worrying about account suspensions or fund freezes. This is particularly important for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and other countries where these platforms are not available or severely restricted.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle charge varying fees, ranging from 2.9% + 30¢ per transaction to 5% + 10¢ per transaction. These fees can add up quickly, especially for creators selling low-priced digital products. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack charges no fees, allowing creators to keep 100% of their revenue. With NOWPayments, creators can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Binance Coin, with transaction fees as low as $0.10 on the BSC, Solana, and TRON networks. By using a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can save money on fees and keep more of their revenue.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks like Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide a permanent structural alternative to traditional payment platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle typically require creators to transfer ownership of their customer data to these platforms, compromising their ability to manage their customer relationships and deliver digital products directly. In contrast, Edge Commerce Stack allows creators to own their customer data, manage subscriptions, and deliver digital products directly to their customers. With Supabase, creators can store customer data securely, and with Cloudflare Pages, they can deliver digital products instantly to their customers without relying on third-party platforms. This level of automation and ownership is critical for creators who want to build a loyal customer base and expand their business without relying on third-party infrastructure.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice between using Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle or Edge Commerce Stack depends on a creator's specific situation. If they are selling digital products in a country where these platforms are available, they may want to consider using these platforms for their ease of use and established payment networks. However, if they are selling digital products in a country where these platforms are restricted or if they want to keep 100% of their revenue without any fees or commission, they may want to consider using Edge Commerce Stack. This stack provides a permanent structural alternative to traditional payment platforms, allowing creators to deploy their own infrastructure, own their customer data, and keep 100% of their revenue without relying on third-party platforms.

Your Deployment Checklist

Start selling digital products to your customers without relying on third-party platforms.
